predictor.load: L[k-7,t] seasonal naive, fallback L[k-1,t] when history < 7 days

fixed_conditions.residual_valid_days: all days with a generated point forecast except day 0, i.e. j >= 1
fixed_conditions.residual_window_rule: the most recent W valid residual dates strictly before the decision day
fixed_conditions.quantile_definition: empirical inverse distribution: sort the m window residuals ascending, take the value at 0-based index ceil(m*alpha)-1
fixed_conditions.fallback_rule: fewer than 7 valid residual dates -> no correction (theta=base), reason recorded
fixed_conditions.tie_rule: candidates within 1e-6 CNY of the window minimum are tied; keep the parameter used the previous day if it is among them, otherwise take the canonical order base, q50, q65, q80, q90
fixed_conditions.observation_assumption: right-endpoint sample = representative power of the preceding 10-minute interval; ideal in-interval fast feedback; the interval-end sample is not treated as known at the interval start

solver.nominal_terminal: E_bar[144] = E[0] = the day actual beginning state

fixed_conditions.fallback_plan: if the MILP returns no usable solution: q = max(protected net demand, 0) with the nominal battery held idle; the event is recorded, never reported as optimal

policies.role: pre-specified main improvement: daily choice among the five rules above
